name: Couchbase
desc: NoSQL document database for modern applications

actions.name: insert_document
actions.description: Create a new document. Fails if document already exists.

actions.name: upsert_document
actions.description: Create or update a document. Creates if it doesn't exist, updates if it does.

actions.name: get_document
actions.description: Retrieve a document by its ID

actions.name: delete_document
actions.description: Remove a document by its ID

actions.name: query
actions.description: Run a SQL++ (N1QL) query with optional vector search filters
